registration: Database server time on first insert; immutable protocol digest and git SHA

primary_entry.selection: first eligible frozen decision per game and exact book/market after registration
primary_entry.side_selection: Within each market select the side with largest strictly positive estimated exact-price EV; ties home/over first; no selection without calibrated probability. Report markets separately, never sum correlated bets as independent games.
primary_entry.input_coverage: All prior current-season eligible FBS games for both teams must pass scoring/drive/PPA audit; missing histories excluded from primary, shown in research diagnostics.

sources.history: CFBD canonical FBS games, stored drives and linked plays
sources.market: immutable game_odds_history exact paired book quote
sources.context: timestamped sourced availability, QB, OL, staff/continuity and forecast weather observations; unknown is explicit

drive_definition.offensive_scoring: Verified offensive TD/FG drive score delta; if TD delta is unusable, recover only from explicit linked scoring-play conversion text (successful kick=7, explicit two-point=8, explicit failed try=6); never assume a PAT. Preserve nonoffensive/OT/remainder separately. A linked Field Goal Good event confirms three points when the drive scoreboard delta is stale.
drive_definition.meaningful: regulation drive containing a non-kneel scrimmage snap; exclude kickoff-only and terminal kneel-only possessions
drive_definition.garbage: fourth-quarter snaps with pre-play absolute margin >=28 excluded from efficiency; retained in full-score audit
drive_definition.unknown: unclassified scoring drive or missing score delta excludes that game from feature training

football_features: offensive points per meaningful regulation drive

fitting.football: Ridge standardized features; alpha=100; chronological training seasons 2022-2024, development 2025, inspected 2026 never confirmation
fitting.market: separate margin/total nonnegative ridge-shrunk residual weight; 0 allowed; fit only earlier development observations at same 3-hour horizon
fitting.distribution: paired empirical held-out rounded margin/total residuals; discrete push mass; separate regularized logistic moneyline fit on earlier out-of-fold predictions
fitting.context: no learned QB/injury/weather coefficient without historical timestamped coverage; missing/unmodeled material context blocks action; no invented point adjustment
fitting.prior_selection: Lowest 2025 margin MAE among the frozen 12 candidates; deterministic grid order breaks ties; final football coefficients refit through 2025 only.
fitting.market_split: Complete 2026 development game dates: first half training, next quarter calibration, final quarter diagnostic evaluation; exclude kickoff+6h at/after development cutoff; at least 20 training/calibration games for fitting/distributions.
fitting.pace: Separate standardized Ridge alpha100 trained on meaningful regulation drive counts using own/opponent drives, both snap tempos and both success rates; predicted drives constrained to [6,18] as an explicit research guard.
fitting.physical_guards: Mean total is at least absolute mean margin and zero; total distribution is floored at zero; rates constrained [0,8] offensive PPD. Discrete marginals are exploratory, not a validated joint score generator.

benchmarks: v1/v2/v3 on same frozen captures when available
metrics: exact-price spread/total/ML paper returns with pushes
same-book close line and price comparison with denominators
evaluation.uncertainty: game-date block bootstrap; withhold intervals below 30 distinct dates; no simulation-count validation
evaluation.promotion: never automatic; at least 200 settled unique primary games across 30 game dates, positive held-out improvement after price/slippage and subsequent untouched confirmation required

immutability: Old forecasts remain unchanged; first eligible decision frozen separately; exact rules, source IDs and coefficients stored per run
implementation_limits: Nonoffensive_or_unattributed is an explicit remainder, not certified defense/special-teams scoring; contradictory drives excluded.
Historical provider timestamps are not reconstructed; all inspected current-year splits are development only.
Fresh context capture does not license an untrained numerical adjustment.

context_shadow.split: first 70% complete game dates fit, later30% diagnostic; at least100 training and30 evaluation games
context_shadow.model: StandardScaler and multi-output Ridge alpha100 fit residual margin/total beyond base; feature order in code frozen
context_shadow.primary_effect: never applied to base decisions; separate development shadow, requires new protocol and untouched confirmation for promotion
